title: C{à}dl{à}guity and compactness in submetric spaces
summary: A submetric space is a topological space equipped with a continuous metric that generates a metric topology weaker than the original one (e.g., a separable Hilbert space with the weak topology). In this paper, we systematically investigate the compactness-related properties of submetric spaces, which make this class of topological spaces a particularly suitable tool for probabilistic applications. As an illustration, we discuss in detail the compactness of the closure of a càdlàg trajectory taking values in a submetric space.
